# Pinterest Korea

> > Pinterest Korea: A visual discovery platform featuring Korean creators, international fanart, DIY tutorials, fashion inspiration, and creative content across art, gaming, sewing, and lifestyle topics.

Pinterest Korea (kr.pinterest.com) serves as the Korean regional hub of Pinterest, showcasing diverse creative content from local and international creators. The platform features artist profiles, tutorial collections, gaming fanart communities (including Limbus Company and Library of Ruina), fashion photography, sewing patterns, and cosplay aesthetics tailored for Korean audiences.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest creator profiles
- Acrylic painting tutorials
- Limbus Company fanart
- Library of Ruina
- Korean gaming community
- Sewing patterns and DIY
- Burda pattern designs
- Maxim Korea magazine
- Cosplay and neko fashion
- Korean comics (manhwa)
- Character art collections
- Beginner art tutorials
- Fashion photography
- Visual inspiration boards
- Creative community content

## Creator Profiles

- [Joony Art (JOONYART1) - Profile | Pinterest](https://kr.pinterest.com/joonyart1/): Joony Art profile: acrylic painting tutorials for beginners on Pinterest

- [림버스 컴퍼니 만화](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/림버스-컴퍼니-만화/912539475083/): Limbus Company game fanart and character comics collection

## Fashion & Lifestyle

- [맥심](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/맥심/936860568236/): Maxim Korea magazine covers featuring models and celebrity photoshoots
- [냥무냥무냥](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/냥무냥무냥/932439141487/): Korean catgirl cosplay and neko aesthetic fashion collection

## DIY & Crafts

- [Выкройка Фуфайки Женской](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/выкройка-фуфайки-женской/914164128543/): Women's quilted jacket sewing patterns collection with Burda designs
